definitions.changes: changes (basis equity_filer_baseline): common shares only, option legs excluded; one filer CIK counts once per ticker; a filer is classified (new / added / trimmed / exited / unchanged) only when it filed a 13F in this dataset for the previous quarter-end. Filers with shares but no previous-quarter filing are counted in no_baseline and in holders, never as buyers. shares_added / shares_removed / net_shares and value_* sum only classified filers; value = |share change| x the quarter-end close. Stock splits are adjusted using the holders' median share ratio; securities first held this quarter (new listings) are excluded from flow rankings. A filer whose traded value exceeds 3x the larger of its two reported holding values (share count and dollar value disagree) is left out of share and value flows; it is still counted as a holder. (flow_excluded_filers counts them.) comparability: comparable | split_adjusted (last quarter's shares x split_factor before classifying) | not_comparable (share and value flows are null) | first_reported (no filer held it last quarter). A null flow means unknown, never zero.
